groups.defect: Guest emails are compared without case normalization, so mixed-case addresses bypass the blacklist and already-present attendees can be added again; server-side dedupe of the input and protection against concurrent inserts are also missing.
groups.rationale: All of them report that the guest filter in addGuests.handler compares emails case-sensitively. s_aed18a73 shares the case-insensitive attendee-duplicate defect and adds the input-dedupe and race issues.

groups.defect: sendAddGuestsEmails receives the raw guests input instead of uniqueGuests, so existing attendees get the wrong email; the catch block also swallows the error without logging it.
groups.rationale: Each one reports passing `guests` instead of `uniqueGuests` to the email call. s_ff822a38 also points out the error is swallowed without logging.

groups.defect: isTeamAdminOrOwner joins isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && instead of ||, so team admins who are not owners are wrongly refused.
groups.rationale: All report the same && versus || mistake in the permission check.

groups.defect: The onError template-string message is always truthy, so the unable_to_add_guests fallback never shows and the toast can read 'undefined: ...'; also, isInvalidEmail and multiEmailValue are not reset on success or when the dialog closes through onOpenChange.
groups.rationale: All three report the dead fallback caused by the always-truthy template string. s_b459ede8 adds the state-reset problem.
